note: Optional bottom plate, F12.10. Plan (x, z) mm in the shell frame (+X = user's left, +Z = nose). Built by 3d/shell/tools/plate_layout.py from shell-theseus-1seam.json; meshed by plate_mesh.mjs.

skates.note: The plate's two skates (F20.1, F20.4): the front one as [x, z] (CCW from below is irrelevant: a closed outline); the back one is its mirror z -> -z. Half-ellipse after the Viper V4 Pro rear skate, straight edge toward the sensor, with a cutout at each corner dot; on the plate alone.

fe.note: Grillage + DKT plate FE (plate v3): PP-C-20A 13.5 GPa, nu 0.35; the skin as DKT triangles, the ribs as T-beams (flange w + 12 t); held at the four screw bosses; 10 N on the lens ring, on the front skate or on the back skate, or the twist (three screws held, 10 N at the fourth). All three at 4.195 g, no rib wider than the 0.6 mm skin (wider members are twin walls). The grid's lens ring follows the stadium as Theseus's does.
